Voxtral 3 introduces a cutting-edge voice agent SDK and state-of-the-art speech models designed for real-time, multi-step conversations across 50+ languages. It combines accurate transcription, natural speech synthesis with emotional adaptability, and deep tool integration for seamless workflow automation. results.title: Mistral Voxtral 3 Cuts Full Voice Agent Pipeline to One SDK at $0.04/min, Beats Whisper
results.content: Voxtral 3 is not Mistral's first attempt at voice. The company launched its initial speech-understanding models in July 2025, followed by Voxtral Transcribe 2 in February 2026 and Voxtral TTS — the first text-to-speech release, supporting 9 languages — in March 2026. What distinguishes the third generation from predecessors is the shift from individual capable components to an opinionated, wired-together stack with an SDK and a single-vendor pricing model. [...] at session start, and an audio watermarking mechanism in the TTS output stream. Penalties for non-compliance run up to €15 million (approximately $16.8 million) or 3% of global annual turnover. Neither compliance requirement is addressed by the Voxtral 3 SDK out of the box — both require additional developer implementation. [...] Prior Voxtral releases gave developers the pieces. Voxtral 3 tells developers how to assemble them, provides the SDK to do it, and offers to host the complete pipeline on Mistral's infrastructure for those who do not want to manage it. The expansion from 9 TTS languages in March 2026 to 35 TTS languages and 50 dialects in October 2026 reflects both improved multilingual model training and a commercial recognition that single-language voice AI has a much smaller addressable market than genuinely multilingual voice AI.

results.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
results.content:
Oct 20, 2026

Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system includes a speech-to-text model (Voxtral Small Transcribe 3), a text-to-speech model (Voxtral Mini TTS 3), and a voice agent SDK based on LiveKit. Together, they combine listening, thinking, tool use, and speaking into a single streaming pipeline. Transcription covers more than 50 languages. Text-to-speech output supports over 35 languages and 50 dialects with emotional adaptation. Agents can tap into external systems during live conversations, for example, to book appointments or check invoices. [...] Mistral says the system can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control. Pricing starts at $0.0035 per minute for transcription. More details are in the documentation.
